response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_group_avg_bandusagepct, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_of_group_telescope_counts FROM (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) g

assumptions.assumption: 'High side of a 4.86 cutoff' means pointaccarc strictly greater than 4.86. Telescopes with a NULL pointaccarc are excluded.
Telescopes whose observatory has a NULL weathprofile are kept and form their own group. The count is the number of telescopes in the group, including those with NULL bandusagepct.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive, so a pointaccarc of 4.86 or more passes.
